info.name: OpenAI Assistants Group organization role assignments API
Lists the organization roles assigned to a group within the organization.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group whose organization role assignments you want to list.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of organization role assignments to return.

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the value from the previous response's `next` field to continue listing organization roles.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for the returned organization roles.

items.docs: Lists the organization roles assigned to a group within the organization.

info.name: Assigns an organization role to a group within the organization.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group that should receive the organization role.

items.docs: Assigns an organization role to a group within the organization.

info.name: Unassigns an organization role from a group within the organization.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group to modify.

params.name: role_id
params.description: The ID of the organization role to remove from the group.

items.docs: Unassigns an organization role from a group within the organization.
